newsitem.title: USA: AlphaNet offers stock at $16.50 a share.
newsitem.headline: AlphaNet offers stock at $16.50 a share.

text.p: AlphaNet Solutions Inc said on Friday that it was offering for sale two million shares of its common stock at $16.50 a share.
Proceeds of the sale will be used to repay bank debt, to expand AlphaNet's services component and possibly to fund acquisitions, the information technology company said.
Of the two million shares, 1,150,000 are being issued and sold by the company and 850,000 are being sold by shareholders, AlphaNet said in a statement.
